PipelineRun.title: Pipeline Run
PipelineRun.description: Records details of an amplicon sequencing pipeline execution including sample count, read yield, and denoising results.

runId.description: Unique identifier for the pipeline run

datasetName.description: Name or title of the processed cohort

sampleCount.description: Total number of FASTQ biological samples in the manifest

totalRawReads.description: Total raw sequenced reads before filtering

GlobalAnalytics.title: Global Analytics Aggregate
GlobalAnalytics.description: Real-time aggregated platform metrics tracking cluster executions and cloud storage across all users.

totalRuns.description: Cumulative total of completed pipeline executions

storageUsedGb.description: Total active cloud storage used in Gigabytes

/pipeline_runs/{runId}.description: Collection of all executed pipeline runs across cohorts.

/pipeline_results/{runId}.description: Full JSON results objects for each run, used for deep data visualization.

/analytics/summary.description: Single document holding aggregated usage statistics.
